title: Mid-range salaries
statementMd:
Return employees earning between 90,000 and 110,000 inclusive.

Expected columns: `first_name`, `last_name`, `salary`.

Tables: `employees`, `departments`.

Row order does not matter.
hints: `BETWEEN a AND b` includes both ends.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT first_name, last_name, salary FROM employees WHERE salary BETWEEN 90000 AND 110000;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
